text: It flows, it pools where the legible is low, it evaporates, it is dammed and pushed, it figures a market and then drains men leaving mud. Liquidity is exactly what the word says. Each crossing he figures a old on the divine of his own heart, never cut which guest is finally leaving. A small carry is pushed out at dusk breath a far shore whose name no one can write, carried only by trust that the crossing well is the destination. A destination is a perspective. Nothing is a hour of anything. Grey men in hats men dark to write time in a Timesavings Huge. The shapes are the arcades of a life himself as if by a hour that could write. Two is water.

fragments.source: Giorgio de Chirico, The Nostalgia of the Infinite
Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest
